docs.text: Cycles-utils is a Python package designed to facilitate Cycles agroecosystem model simulations. This package provides a number of tools for users to prepare Cycles simulation input files, run Cycles simulations, and post-process Cycles simulation results. For basic usage examples, please refer to this Jupyter notebook . For more complex usage examples, please refer to this Colab notebook . To install: pip install Cycles-utils Developed by: Yuning Shi (yshi.at.psu.edu)

The parameter names should be in lowercase and correspond to the fields in Cycles simulation control files. If a field is not provided, it will be filled with a default value. If a field's value is a callable, it will be called with the simulation_dict to resolve its value. Parameters: fn ( str | Path ) – Destination control file path. user_dict ( dict ) – Values or callables for control fields. simulation_dict ( dict [ str , Any ] | None , default: None ) – Optional simulation row for callable resolution.
